description: Calls and credits spent, per operation. granularity=summary (default) gives totals per op; daily gives a day-by-day series including storage charges; storage gives the daily stored-vector count and storage credits. Use days (1-365) or a from/to date range (YYYY-MM-DD). Free.

from.description: Start date YYYY-MM-DD (with to; not for storage).

to.description: End date YYYY-MM-DD (with from; not for storage).
